Paragraph: "Thus they reached to one course of return, after hopping from one mountain to the other, shuddering mountains and even their peaks by their trample in hastiness..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: High-velocity chaotic movement driven by panic.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: The monkeys hop wildly across mountain peaks, causing physical disturbance due to their haste.
Outcome/Resolution: They reach a consolidated point after a chaotic flight.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Anxiety: Panic Flight, Chaotic Energy, Agitated Haste

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Avegata (Impulsive velocity and erratic force propelled by intense panic)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: External turbulence and hasty leaps reflect an unanchored mind rushing in reaction to illusion.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: High arousal somatic behavior: frantic movement and physical displacement resulting from panic discharges.
